description: This PHP source file defines the EventDispatcherDebugCommand class within the OrangeHRM application. The class creates a console command that allows debugging of the event dispatcher by listing event listeners, their order, and priorities during execution.

classes.name: EventDispatcherDebugCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command that outputs the current event listeners and their priorities for debugging purposes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with a SymfonyStyle object for styled console output.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command, instantiating the application kernel, handling a request, and outputting all registered event listeners with their priorities.
